title: Acceptance saturating counter
behavior: Unsigned 4-bit saturating counter. On rising clk: synchronous active-high reset sets count to 0; otherwise enable increments unless count is 15. Hold when disabled or saturated. full continuously equals (count == 15).
clock_reset: Rising-edge clk. Synchronous active-high reset has priority over enable. No asynchronous reset.

requirements.text: Reset sets count to zero on the next rising edge, regardless of enable.
requirements.acceptance: Reset at zero, middle and saturation; check reset asserted between edges does not change count until the edge.

requirements.text: Increment by one on each enabled non-reset rising edge; otherwise hold.
requirements.acceptance: Use directed and deterministic seeded enable/reset sequences against a Python reference, with falling-edge drive and post-edge sampling.

requirements.text: Hold at 15 until reset, with full equal to count == 15.
requirements.acceptance: Run beyond 16 enabled cycles; verify no wrap and full at boundary and after reset.
